content.tex: A INVESTIGATION (QUESTIONS 1 to 4)
CONNECTING DOTS (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This investigation looks at the number of ways of connecting dots using straight lines.
This diagram shows 1 dot. There is 1 row and 1 column. This is a 1 by 1 diagram. There are no connections to other dots.
This diagram shows 4 dots. There are 2 rows and 2 columns.
This is a 2 by 2 diagram.

There are 6 ways to join 2 dots. These are: \(\bullet 2\) vertical connectors (solid lines) \(\bullet 2\) horizontal connectors (solid lines) \(\bullet 1\) up diagonal connector (dashed line) \(\bullet 1\) down diagonal connector (dashed line).
